data.title: 墨染希 · 晨光烘焙坊的围裙甜点
data.description: 晨光柔和的咖啡馆操作间内飘溢着刚出炉烤饼的奶油香气。希系着浅黄色围裙，袖口挽至臂弯，露出如白玉般细腻的小臂。她捧着刚出炉的精美点心转过身，黑瞳中盛满了晨曦暖意与毫无保留的宠溺微笑，脸颊上还可爱地带着一小抹面粉。
data.location: bright cozy bakery preparation kitchen with warm wooden counters
data.action: holding tray of freshly baked pastries in sunlit cafe kitchen, yellow apron tied neatly, flour smudge on blushing cheek, sweet welcoming smile
data.lighting: warm cheerful morning sunlight flooding through kitchen glass
data.mood: heartwarming sweet domesticity, endearing devoted affection
data.promptProse: Standing in a sunlit bakery kitchen, Nozomi holds a tray of fresh golden pastries with an apron tied over a simple top. A touch of white flour dots her blushing cheek as she offers a warm, affectionate smile.
data.animaCaption: Nozomi in an apron holding fresh pastries in a sunny bakery kitchen, smiling with a flour smudge.
